mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and compresses valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength (PAYEMS) and housing demand (HOUST) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it indicates a robust economic expansion that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when both PAYEMS and HOUST are above their 12-month moving averages are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDPC1 growth above 2% and CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year), a positive trend in consumer spending (RSAFS) supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, the positive trend in RSAFS does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns (i.e., returns are negative or not significantly positive).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 (a 10% decline from 2017 base), it signals a weakening economy that increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns when INDPRO < 105.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases short-term equity risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns when UNRATE < 3.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
